name: Slideshow Skew Stretch
description: Full-screen image slideshow where slides move vertically with a skewed, stretched parallax transition, driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag move to the next or previous slide, looping at the ends
Outgoing and incoming images rotate and stretch on the Y axis while sliding for a skew effect
Input is locked while a transition runs
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Transition duration, easing, parallax, rotation and stretch amounts
Wheel sensitivity, background and text colors
Navigation button visibility, size, colors and hint text

needsCodeEdit.where: The two button elements using ← and →

needsCodeEdit.change: Move the navigation controls to another corner
needsCodeEdit.where: The bottom-8 right-8 class on the navigation wrapper

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which input types trigger navigation

fixed: Fills the viewport height and stays hidden until images are preloaded
Captures wheel, touch and pointer input over the slideshow area
